title: How to Crochet Squares in Spiral Rounds (1st Variant: Symmetrical Square)
author: Supergurumi
notes: 1st variant (symmetrical square) only; the 2nd (whirl) variant on the same page is not included. Worked in continuous spiral rounds (no joins). Rounds 1-6 make the square as published ('Done is an even square'); the optional extension rounds 7-14 are omitted (note: the page's Round 10 count '(74 stitches)' looks like a typo for 76). Added 'Make a magic ring.' start line (Round 1 works into the Magic Ring).
